## Findings

- [ ] **[Security/WARN] Secret scanning non-provider patterns disabled (repeat of 2026-08-13)**
  - **Status quo:** `secret_scanning` and `secret_scanning_push_protection` are enabled, but `secret_scanning_non_provider_patterns.status` is still `disabled`. Generic secrets in non-standard token formats are not scanned. Unchanged since the previous audit flagged it; no code evidence of a gap (0 open secret-scanning alerts), so this is optional hardening, not an active risk.
  - **Proposed solution:** Enable non-provider pattern scanning in the repo security settings (settings toggle, no code PR possible). Note it can produce occasional false positives.
  - **Effort/Impact:** Low effort / low impact.

## Verified highlights (evidence)

- **About sidebar:** description set ("Public website for the Symaira local-first AI tool ecosystem."), homepage `https://symaira.com`, 5 topics including `typescript` (`ai-agents`, `local-first`, `react`, `vite`).
- **Merge policy:** squash-only (`allow_squash_merge: true`, merge/rebase disabled), `deleteBranchOnMerge: true` — consistent, no branch clutter. Auto-merge disabled; not flagged (no auto-merge usage in PR history).
- **Branch protection on `main`:** required status checks `lint-build` + `test` with `strict: true`; both contexts match real jobs in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (verified against the latest green runs). PR reviews required with approval count 0 — correct for a solo repo (viewer permission ADMIN, single maintainer). Conversation resolution on, `enforce_admins` on, force-push and deletion disabled.
- **Community profile:** health 100% (README, LICENSE, `.github/CONTRIBUTING.md`, `.github/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`, `.github/SECURITY.md`, YAML issue forms + `config.yml`, PR template all present).
- **CI:** `ci.yml` (lint+build, test on `pull_request`), `codeql.yml` (PR/push/weekly schedule), `deploy.yml` (push to main, FTPS). All actions pinned to major versions (`actions/checkout@v7`, `actions/setup-node@v7`, `github/codeql-action@v3`, `SamKirkland/FTP-Deploy-Action@v4.4.0`); every workflow sets least-privilege `permissions:`.
- **Security alerts:** 0 open Dependabot, 0 open code-scanning, 0 open secret-scanning alerts.
- **Release:** v0.1.1 published 2026-08-13 with non-empty notes; tag points at HEAD (distance 0); consistent `vX.Y.Z` scheme.
- **Labels:** `priority: urgent/high/medium/low`, `feature`, `bug` present; no duplicate semantics. No `auto-*` labels and no autonomous-protocol PR history — that check is not applicable here.

## Not flagged (deliberate)

- `licenseInfo: "Other"` — the LICENSE is intentionally proprietary ("All rights reserved", GitHub-ToS viewing/forking only). Product decision, not a gap.
- `dismiss_stale_reviews: false` — no behavioral effect with approval count 0 on a solo repo.
- README is concise (32 non-blank lines) but complete for a deployed product site: badges, hero image, product story, development, stack. No install section needed (the product is the deployed URL).
- Projects v2: not auditable this run — token lacks `read:project` scope (`unknown (scope missing)`).
- `.github/audit/`, `.github/review/`, `.github/coverage/` report files are versioned in this repo by convention (#28); the upstream suggestion to gitignore them does not apply here.
